title: Hold a pawnbrokers licence
what: Lend money on pawned goods only as a licensed pawnbroker, and only at a place the licence authorises.

laws.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
laws.provisions: s 6(3), sch 3, definition of pawnbroker, s 51

sources.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on a business of advancing, on interest or in expectation of profit or reward, an amount on the principal or collateral security of property taken by the person as a pawn unless the person is a pawnbroker

sources.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: pawnbroker means a person who— (a) carries on the business of advancing, on interest or in expectation of profit or reward, an amount on the principal or collateral security of property taken by the person as a pawn; and (b) holds a pawnbrokers licence

sources.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.quote: A pawnbroker must not carry on business as a pawnbroker at a place other than an authorised place

administration.who: Chief executive of the department administering the Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)

sources.title: Second-hand Dealers and Pawnbrokers Act 2003 (Qld)
sources.locator: s 12, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026) (current)
sources.quote: the chief executive must refuse to grant the licence if the chief executive is not satisfied the applicant is a suitable person to hold the licence.

reach.condition: if it lends money on pawned goods (a pawnbroker)
